experiment: Exp B B1 — Transformer-lineage architectures vs matched GPT-2 (converged 512k, like-for-like train_hf denominators)
headline_metric: algorithm-CEG = GPU-hours for the arch to reach its matched GPT-2 baseline's neutral-BPB threshold, relative to the baseline (same axis as the completed study's algorithm multiplier). Data held fixed (OWT) so NO data/Shapley decomposition.
ceg_framing: EVERY Exp B arm is CENSORED: its converged neutral BPB stays ABOVE the matched GPT-2 threshold (delta > 0), so it never crosses -> algorithm-CEG <= 1x (no measurable algorithm gain). No finite <1x multiplier exists for a never-crossing arm; rendered as a censored marker at the 1x parity line on results/multipliers_vs_scale.png. 'delta' (neutral-BPB gap vs the matched GPT-2, >0=worse) is the underlying measurement.
